run.environment: Local controllable Playwright with real Astro, Vite, Bun/Elysia, and disposable PostgreSQL
run.data_mode: Synthetic fixture in a unique disposable PostgreSQL cluster; aggregate-only persistence evidence
limitations: No Maestri Portal was connected; explicitly authorized local controllable Playwright was used and this was non-blocking.
Campaign-entry resolution and analytics-after-consent were not exercised by this scaffold.
Accessibility evidence is semantic, keyboard, responsive, and screenshot based; it is not a full assistive-technology matrix.

journeys.name: Browse marketing, legal content, keyboard navigation, and mobile navigation
evidence: Desktop main landmark, named primary navigation, and visible H1 asserted.
Keyboard skip link focus and activation asserted.
Privacy page and named mobile navigation dialog asserted.
Console errors, page errors, failed requests, and HTTP >=400 collections were empty.

journeys.name: Submit visible public contact form and retain one delivery plus one lead after reload
evidence: Visible form submitted through accessible labels, explicit consent, and official dummy Turnstile credentials.
Real POST /leads response status was 201 and the visible success state stabilized.
Bounded aggregate query returned deliveries=1 and leads=1 before and after reload.
No payload or PII was printed; console errors, page errors, failed requests, and HTTP >=400 collections were empty.

journeys.name: Report database outage through readiness without losing liveness, then recover
evidence: During owned PostgreSQL outage, /health returned 200 and /ready converged to 503.
After the same PostgreSQL cluster resumed, /ready recovered to 200.

screenshots.checkpoint: Desktop marketing home with privacy choice
observations: Clear visual hierarchy, readable privacy choice, and unobstructed primary CTA.
Legal heading and body content are readable with no overlay.
Dialog fits the viewport, labels are readable, and the background is visibly modal.
Labels, field grouping, consent, and submit action are unobstructed.
Success heading, next steps, contact link, and CTA are sharp and unobstructed.
Success content reflows without horizontal clipping or dev-toolbar obstruction.
Form returns empty and usable; controls and consent remain readable and unobstructed.

access_checks.vector: Public intake through connector public ID supplied only to the test API process
access_checks.evidence: One accepted delivery and one lead were confirmed through aggregate counts only; no payload or PII was emitted.

findings.title: Cookie banner obscured initial intake evidence
evidence: Journey now makes the visible essential-only privacy choice before form capture; corrective reruns passed.

findings.title: Transition, dev toolbar, and viewport timing obscured success evidence
evidence: Capture waits for computed stable styles, hides only the dev-only toolbar, and uses explicit desktop/mobile viewports; final screenshots were inspected.

findings.title: No Maestri Portal connected
evidence: maestri list exposed agents and the initiative note but no Portal; the human explicitly authorized local controllable Playwright as non-blocking.

verification.evidence: bunx biome check apps/web/tests/e2e-integrated: 6 files checked, no fixes applied.
Seven final desktop/mobile artifacts inspected; no clipping, obstruction, blur, or unexpected dev UI remained.
